install.detail: release tarbally bez uctu/loginu; install.sh (deb+systemd user) nespusten. 1 gateway + driver; docker driver 2 kontejnery/sandbox, vm driver libkrun. Nutny gateway_jwt bundle + allow_unauthenticated_users pro lokal.

headless.detail: create --detach --no-tty + exec --no-tty bez TTY; gateway jako root pres sudo

adapter.detail: adapters/openshell.py (docker i vm); tar pres stdin OK; jmeno sandboxu max 19 znaku -> task_id max 6 znaku

cold_start.detail: docker driver 1.30 s, vm driver 2.24 s median (lokalni image; prvni VM build 16.7 s)

egress.detail: default-deny, probe: vse blokovano na obou driverech; external_dns v probe falesny poplach (syntetic IP 198.18.x, connect EACCES); DNS tunel neoverena

credentials.detail: placeholder v env, real hodnota jen v hlavicce na hostitelskem echo serveru; mismatch host -> 403 credential_endpoint_mismatch; nepovoleny host -> EACCES; docker i vm

gateway.detail: nginx bez IP mapy: provider s FAKE-SECRET v Authorization dorazil nginx->LiteLLM (401 'Received=FAKE****-123'), /key/generate 403; pkg proxy OK (tls: skip); docker i vm

compose.detail: 0/15, zamerne: dockerd -> 'dockerd needs to be started with root privileges...'; uid 1000, CapEff=0, NoNewPrivs, unshare -Ur EPERM (docker i vm). Zdrojaky: root odmitnut validaci, CLONE_NEWUSER natvrdo v seccomp, zadny knob. Rootless nelze.

isolation.detail: sandboxy bez sit. rozhrani, nevidi se, vlastni disk; host LAN/loopback/gateway porty blokovany; libkrun nezarucuje omezeni na bind mount (doc)

lifecycle.detail: stop/start OK, 3 paralelni OK; suspend/resume/snapshot nepodporovano v obou driverech; po davkovem mazani zustaly VM procesy (leak) - jednoduchy delete OK

verdict: Policy a credential injection jsou silne a funguji na obou driverech, LiteLLM klic z provideru dorazi az do LiteLLM. Compose/dockerd se nespusti nikdy: root, capabilities a user namespaces jsou zamerne zakazane bez konfiguracni vyjimky.
